data.description:
## What
Extend the completion-verifier protocol: when a story DD's verification evidence contains "deferred to operator" / "rollout-time" / "post-merge validation" / similar phrasing, the verifier auto-creates an obligation ticket parented to the story with a configurable deadline (default 30 days), owner=operator, and validation command. Verifier emits P1=PASS only if the obligation ticket creation succeeds. Add an obligation-monitor script and a DD-lint advisory.

## Why
Bug 1761's structural fix. Without this, the new epic's Story 4 (live phased rollout, inherently validation-class) reproduces the same "deferred to operator" escape valve that allowed epic 4047 to close P1=PASS with the load-bearing implementation unbuilt.

## Done Definitions
- Verifier protocol extension: running `dso:completion-verifier` against a fixture story whose DD evidence section contains the regex `\\b(deferred|defer)\\s+to\\s+(operator|rollout|post.?merge|operator.?execution)\\b` produces an obligation ticket (`ticket list --type=task --tag=obligation:rollout`) with `parent_id == <fixture story id>`. P1=PASS emitted iff the obligation ticket created successfully. P1=FAIL otherwise. Behavior pinned by a unit test that mocks the ticket CLI and asserts the create call.
- Obligation-monitor script `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler_audits/check-obligations.sh` (or equivalent): iterates `ticket list --tag=obligation:rollout`; for each whose deadline (parsed from ticket description) is in the past AND status != closed, files a P1 bug via `ticket create bug --parent=<obligation's parent story>` with body "OBLIGATION OVERDUE: <details>". Behavior test: fixture with one past-deadline obligation → monitor exits 0 (not an error) AND produces exactly 1 bug ticket parented correctly.
- Backfill for epic 4047 / story 83ac: 4 obligation tickets created retroactively against story 83ac (or noted as "discharged by this epic" if the validation evidence is being produced by Story 4 of THIS epic). Recorded via ticket comments on 83ac.
- DD-lint advisory script `plugins/dso/scripts/lint-story-dds.sh`: invoked at `/dso:preplanning` close (or as a standalone tool). For a story id argument, parses the Done Definitions section; warns to stderr when no DD contains a behavioral verb from the configurable allowlist (default: `produces|writes|appears|emits|outputs|creates|removes|drops|increases|decreases|returns.*shape|file.*exists|file.*content`). Returns 0 (advisory only). Behavior test: shape-only fixture story → warning emitted; behavior-paired fixture → silent.
- Skill amendments: `plugins/dso/agents/completion-verifier.md` reflects the new contract. `plugins/dso/docs/VERIFIER-PROTOCOL.md` documents the obligation-ticket lifecycle and the regex for triggering it. `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/obligation-ticket-schema.md` (new) specifies the obligation ticket format.
- Unit + integration tests pass; lint + format pass.

## Implementation Notes
- Obligation ticket schema: `type=task`, `tags=[obligation:rollout, <story-id>]`, description contains:
  ```
  ## Obligation
  Parent story: <id>
  Deadline: <ISO-8601 date>
  Owner: operator
  Validation command: <verbatim command>
  Closure: comment with output of validation command + transition to closed
  ```
- Don't try to enforce this on EVERY story retroactively — only on stories in this epic (the new one) + epic 4047's story 83ac (backfilled). Future-broad rollout is a follow-on plan-improvement story.
- The DD-lint script is ADVISORY, not blocking. We don't want to break /dso:preplanning for existing stories that pre-date this contract. False positives in advisory mode are tolerable.

## Closure Checks
- Verifier produces obligation tickets for "deferred" DD phrasing AND only emits P1=PASS when the obligation creates successfully.
- Obligation monitor catches past-deadline obligations and files parented bugs.
- Story 83ac backfilled with 4 obligations (or noted-as-discharged).
- DD-lint script is advisory (returns 0 always), warns on shape-only DD sets.
data.title: As a planning agent, I want completion-verifier to refuse 'deferred to operator execution' as DD satisfaction without producing a tracked obligation ticket
